g.text: Four years of hourly synthetic solar wind (recurrent streams, CMEs, random Bz) drive the O'Brien-McPherron Burton-type Dst model with
pressure correction and 2 nT noise. Years 1-3 train, year 4 tests; inputs: 6 hours of past Dst, and for ARX/MLP 7 hours of L1 VBs (one
hour ahead of Earth) and dynamic pressure.
